name: Clonazolam

tolerance.full: within a couple of days of continuous use

summary: A long lasting benzodiazepine with heavily hypnotic effects. The safety profile is not well established, and there have been reports that people taking it three days in a row have had a seizure. Most comparable to Triazolam, but with a much longer half-life.
metabolism: Stays in the body for about 3.6 hours and is broken down extensively, coming out mainly as the amino and acetamino forms. The main breakdown products are 7-aminoclonazolam, hydroxyclonazolam and 7-acetaminoclonazolam, and all of them leave in the urine. How much of it spreads through the body is not known.
